title: An ample invertible sheaf realizes a scheme as an open subscheme of Proj
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with an ample invertible sheaf $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then there exist a nonnegatively graded commutative ring $S$ and an open immersion $X\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj].

source.place: Properties Proposition 01Q3 (properties-proposition-characterize-ample), implication (1) => (2), with S = Gamma_*(X, L)

proof.text: Form the explicit section ring S = InvertibleSectionRing L with grading sectionRingGrade L. Apply [lem-sc-ample-finite-affine-cover] to obtain positive powers n_i, global sections s_i, and affine opens U_i covering X with U_i = X_{s_i}. Embed each s_i into degree n_i by DirectSum.of; evaluation in that degree is s_i (DirectSum.of_eq_same). These homogeneous sections verify the cover hypothesis of [lem-sc-ample-proj-local-chart], which provides f : X -> Proj(S).

source.place: Properties Proposition 01Q3, implication (1) => (2), Lemma 01PZ, and Lemma 01Q1 proof, first paragraph

proof.text: Put V_i = D_+(s_i). By [lem-sc-ample-proj-local-chart], f^{-1}(V_i) = X_{s_i} = U_i, and ampleness together with the affineness of U_i gives IsIso (f restricted to V_i). The inverse-image identities and the cover of X show that the image of f is contained in the union of the V_i.

source.place: Properties Lemma 01Q1 proof, paragraphs beginning 'The inverse image of D_+(s_i)' and 'By Lemma 01PW'

proof.text: Apply Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_range_subset_iSup with P = IsOpenImmersion and target opens V_i. The preceding step supplies the image containment and an isomorphism over every V_i; each isomorphism is an open immersion. This proves f is an open immersion, including when the finite index set is empty. Return S, its explicit commutative ring instance, its grading and graded-ring instance, and f as the required existential witnesses.

source.place: Properties Lemma 01Q1 proof, final two sentences
